headline: Rotterdam Biofuel Bunker Premium Widens as VLSFO Prices Drop
summary: Rotterdam's B30-VLSFO biofuel bunker price rose $7/mt over the past week, while conventional VLSFO dropped $48/mt to $678/mt. The price premium for B30 biofuel widened by $55/mt to $194/mt.
why: Price spreads between low-sulfur fuel oil and biofuel blends dictate the adoption speed of renewable fuels in European marine shipping.
